newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends down, May liquidation focus.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends down, May liquidation focus.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed lower amid steady speculative liquidation in the spot May contract and only sporadic buying by the trade, dealers said.
Open interest for July delivery rose 114 lots to 3,176 lots as of Monday's close.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30.
Trade buying in the May/July switch held the spot month at 11.10 cents a lb, where dealers pegged support for May sugar. The spread closed at 0.12 compared with 0.11 at Monday's close.
Firmer support was cited between 10.80 and 10.90 cents, and resistance at last week's high of 11.38 cents for the May contract.
May finished down 0.11 cent at 11.13 cents after trading from 11.21 to 11.12. Most-active July fell 0.11 to 11.02, while the remaining months eased between 0.08 and 0.03 cent.
Volume was estimated at 22,714 lots compared with Monday's official 28,276 lots.
Amid a lack of any significant physical offtake or supportive fundamental news, traders expect May to rack up additional losses as speculators continue to liquidate long positions.
Players dismissed a strike at Brazil's key port of Santos.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodity Desk, 212 859 1640))
